question.text: Volumes accompanying price trends in TA are used to:

answer.text: Confirm strength/weakness of the underlying trend

explanation.text: The Logic: Strong volumes confirm trends; weak volumes signal weakening. The Trap: Dividends and earnings are fundamental, not TA. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: A volume spike on breakouts often separates real moves from fakeouts.
